description: This file defines a Java interface named Packaging that declares methods related to retrieving package details for shipping, based on a list of products and a merchant store.

methods.name: getBoxPackagesDetails
methods.description: Returns a list of package details for the box packages based on a list of shipping products and a merchant store, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: getItemPackagesDetails
methods.description: Returns a list of package details for individual items based on a list of shipping products and a merchant store, may throw ServiceException.
